Buffalo Wild Wings Wing Deal Guide: Get Buy One Get One Free Wings, Order Delivery & More Specials Daily

When you crave wings, beer, and a great deal, Buffalo Wild Wings (BWW) is the ultimate place to be. Whether you’re hunting for buy one get one free wings, want to know how to get exclusive delivery or pick up promos, or you’re just wondering about the best daily wing specials, this ultimate guide has you covered. Want to see how wings became an American sports bar staple? Check out this food history piece by Smithsonian Magazine.

This complete breakdown reveals everything about BWW’s boneless wings, traditional wings, burgers, mozzarella sticks, sauces, BOGO offers, Wild Herd Rewards perks, Happy Hour deals, and how to get the most value every single day — whether you’re dining in, taking out, or ordering delivery.

The Ultimate Buffalo Wild Wings Wing Special: Why Fans Love It

Buffalo Wild Wings has built a reputation as the ultimate wing sport bar for a reason — legendary sauces, huge TVs for every sport, and deals that make ordering wings and burgers even better. If you’re curious about how sports bars shape game day culture in the US, read this article from USA Today.

BWW’s buy one get one free wings (BOGO) and daily specials help fans enjoy their favorite food without breaking the bank. Plus, the Wild Herd Rewards program stacks extra perks for loyal wing lovers.

Daily Wing Deals: What You Can Get at Buffalo Wild Wings

Buffalo Wild Wings has daily deals that rotate throughout the week. From boneless wings on Monday to traditional wings on Tuesday — and even new limited-time bundles — there’s always an option to get wings at a great value.

Monday: Boneless Wings BOGO Special

Monday is a big one at BWW. Buy one, get one free boneless wings is the standard special. This means if you order 6 boneless wings, you’ll get 6 more — absolutely free.

Available for Dine-In, Delivery, or Pick Up

Most locations offer this deal for dine-in, delivery, or pick up. Check your Buffalo Wild Wings near you to confirm the offer.

Tuesday: Traditional Wings BOGO Classic

If you’re a traditional wing fan, Tuesday is your day. The buy one get one free traditional wings deal is iconic — order your first basket and get a second order free.

How to Order Traditional Wings for BOGO

This deal is usually available every Tuesday at participating restaurants. You can order online, choose delivery or pick up, or enjoy the wings fresh while watching your favorite sport.

Other Daily Specials You Shouldn’t Miss

Aside from the big Monday and Tuesday wing deals, Buffalo Wild Wings often runs limited-time promos, special sauce launches, exclusive delivery offers, and BWW app-only deals.

Check the BWW website and your Wild Herd account to see what new specials are running today.

Happy Hour at Buffalo Wild Wings: Get Discounted Beer, Wings & Mozzarella Sticks

The BWW Happy Hour is a classic. Many locations feature a daily Happy Hour where you can get discounted beer, wings, mozzarella sticks, and shareable bundles.

What’s Available at Happy Hour?

  • Discounted traditional or boneless wings

  • Mozzarella sticks & fried pickles

  • Beer specials on select domestic drafts

  • Onion rings & salsa combos

Happy Hour times may vary by location, so check with the Buffalo Wild Wings near you.

The Buffalo Wild Wings Menu: Wings, Burgers & More

Buffalo Wild Wings isn’t just about wings — the menu includes burgers, wraps, fried pickles, onion rings, and crowd-pleasers like mozzarella sticks and salsa dips.

How to Order Buffalo Wild Wings Delivery or Pick Up

Order delivery or pick up directly through the BWW app or site for exclusive perks. Third-party services like DoorDash or Uber Eats may have different deals, but ordering direct often gets you Wild Herd Rewards.

New Limited-Time Wing Sauces & Specials

BWW is famous for launching new sauces, like Mango Habanero or Asian Zing. Keep an eye on seasonal deals and sauce features. Sometimes these come with buy one get one free promotions or special bundle deals.

Wild Herd Rewards: Get Free Wings & Exclusive Deals

Joining the Wild Herd loyalty program is a no-brainer. You get points for every dollar you spend, and you can redeem them for free wings, burgers, sauces, or drinks.

Wild Herd Perks Include:

  • Free wings on sign-up (often a buy one get one free coupon)

  • Free birthday wings

  • Early access to new sauce flavors

  • Special delivery promos

  • Member-exclusive daily deals

BWW Wing Bundles: Ultimate Game Day Packs

Watching the game at home? Buffalo Wild Wings offers bundle packs — wings, fries, salsa, onion rings, and beer combos to feed your crew.

These are often available for delivery or pick up only, making them perfect for parties.

How to Find a Buffalo Wild Wings Near You

The easiest way is to search Buffalo Wild Wings near me on Google or maps. Or visit the BWW website to check your closest restaurant, menu, Happy Hour, and daily specials.

Buffalo Wild Wings Burgers: Don’t Sleep on Them!

Though wings steal the spotlight, BWW’s burgers are an underrated deal. Try them during Happy Hour or bundle them with wings for the ultimate combo.

Mozzarella Sticks & Fried Pickles: Perfect Wing Sides

Order mozzarella sticks, fried pickles, onion rings, or salsa with your wings. Many daily deals bundle them at a discount, especially during Happy Hour.

Tips to Maximize Buffalo Wild Wings Daily Specials

Here’s how to get the best bang for your buck every time you order:

  • Join Wild Herd Rewards for BOGO wing perks.

  • Order on Mondays and Tuesdays for boneless or traditional wing BOGOs.

  • Use delivery or pick up promos for added discounts.

  • Visit during Happy Hour for beer and sides specials.

  • Watch for new limited-time sauces and event bundles.

  • Follow BWW on social for secret deals and promo codes.

  • Ask about local specials — some places run their own deals.

Ultimate BWW Sport Watching Experience

There’s a reason BWW calls itself the ultimate sport bar. Multiple screens, surround sound, and wing deals make it the go-to place for big games. Bundle your boneless wings, beer, and mozzarella sticks — and get comfortable!

Delivery or Pick Up: Which is Better?

Both have perks! Delivery means wings at your door — but picking up often scores you exclusive in-store deals or Wild Herd Rewards you won’t get through third-party services.

Get Free Wings: Limited-Time Promos to Watch

Every year, BWW launches limited-time promos like:

  • Monday BOGO boneless wings

  • Tuesday BOGO traditional wings

  • Free wings for Wild Herd sign-ups

  • Game Day bundle discounts

  • Free mozzarella sticks with large orders

  • Buy one get one burger or wing basket deals

These may vary by location and season.

BWW Events & Seasonal Sports Offers

Buffalo Wild Wings often runs special deals for major sports events: Super Bowl, March Madness, NBA playoffs, and more. Expect big BOGO wing specials, beer discounts, and ultimate party bundles.

Don’t Forget the Sauces: The Heart of Buffalo Wild Wings

BWW’s signature sauces — like Asian Zing, Honey BBQ, and Blazin’ Carolina Reaper — are what make each wing order special. Mix and match sauces for your perfect combo.

Hungry for more daily specials at a lively sports bar? Don’t miss our full guide to Miller’s Ale House Daily Specials: Best Sports Bar Lunch & Drink Deals Near You to discover unbeatable menu options and great deals near you.

BWW FAQs

Are BWW Daily Specials Available for Delivery?

Yes! Most deals like BOGO wings are available for delivery or pick up — but check your local BWW for details.

Does Buffalo Wild Wings Have Happy Hour?

Yes! Many locations run daily Happy Hour specials with beer, burgers, mozzarella sticks, onion rings, and wings discounts.

What’s the Wild Herd?

The Wild Herd Rewards program is BWW’s loyalty club for free wings, BOGO deals, birthday perks, and more.

Does BWW Offer BOGO Wings Every Day?

Not every day — but Monday and Tuesday are your go-to BOGO wing days. Watch for new promos too.

Explore our complete guide on BJs daily specials deals happy hours full menu prices pizookie deals for all the latest BJs deals and Pizookie offers.

Final Thoughts: Get the Best Buffalo Wild Wings Deal Today

Now you know exactly how to get the ultimate Buffalo Wild Wings experience — BOGO wings, free delivery or pick up perks, daily specials, Happy Hour deals, burgers, mozzarella sticks, and Wild Herd bonuses. To see how Buffalo Wild Wings competes with other casual sports bar chains, check out Nation’s Restaurant News chain rankings.

So next time you’re craving wings, grab your friends, choose your favorite sauce, and get the deal that makes every game day, event, or casual lunch special.

Note: Prices and specials may vary by location. Always check your local Buffalo Wild Wings near you for the latest daily deals, promos, Happy Hour times, and delivery or pick up options.

Ready to Get Free Wings Today?

Sign up for Wild Herd, order your favorite wings, and enjoy buy one get one free offers — every Monday and Tuesday!
